summary: First test pass of the Médical o2 Expo app (frontend + backend). Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_api.py with 7 tests (health, chat validation, SSE stream, history persistence, clear, empty history). All 7 pass after one fix. Frontend: exercised the full flow on mobile viewport 390x844 - 4 tabs, add-night sheet (hours stepper, day/feeling selectors, save, same-date overwrite, delete, persistence after reload), guides list (8 items, PPC detail with 5 steps, back nav), entretien screen (6 tasks, mark done re-sorts to end), FAQ (toggle open/close), assistant suggestion auto-sends and chat displays the expected 'Assistant indisponible pour le moment.' error gracefully with no crash, user message persisted via /api/chat/{sid}/messages, and chat-clear-button wipes history. Known LLM budget 0.0 is handled correctly end-to-end. One real backend bug was found and fixed: MongoDB '_id' was leaking into GET /api/chat/{session_id}/messages because FastAPI defaults response_model_by_alias=True; frontend expected 'id'. Fixed by adding response_model_by_alias=False on that route.

issues: The sheet is tall (maxHeight 92%); day/feeling/save controls sit below the fold on 390x844 and require scrolling inside the ScrollView. Content remains reachable, but on first open only 'Quelle nuit' row is visible above the fold - consider slightly compacting field spacing or starting sheet scroll closer to the top so the Save button is reachable without scrolling.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' React Native Web deprecation notice - verify no shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset usage in StyleSheet; replace with boxShadow for web or use elevation + platform split.

action_items: Optional: audit StyleSheet.create for shadow* props and migrate to boxShadow / platform-specific styles to silence the React Native Web deprecation warning.
Optional UX: reduce vertical padding inside add-night-sheet (fieldLabel marginTop space.xl + stepper height) so the Save button is visible without inner scroll on 390x844.
No functional fix needed for the chat flow - the budget-exhausted path is handled correctly (error bubble shown, user message persisted, done event closes the stream, no crash).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_messages leaked Mongo '_id' because FastAPI defaults response_model_by_alias=True while BaseDocument aliases id -> _id. Fixed with response_model_by_alias=False. Consider setting this globally or using model_dump(by_alias=False) if more routes return BaseDocument subclasses.

chat.tsx line 97: res.json() is called without checking res.ok. If the history endpoint errors, this will throw before the catch resets state - the current try/catch handles it but a 404/500 shape would still parse as JSON garbage. Fine for now.
store.tsx: deleteLog/markDone call storage.setItem inside the setState updater - works but is a side effect inside a reducer; acceptable here but noted.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of exercised flows (home, suivi CRUD + persistence + overwrite, guides nav + detail, entretien mark-done, FAQ toggle, assistant suggestion->chat auto-send, chat error handling, chat history persistence, chat clear)

seed_data_creation: No seed data. Tests use unique session_ids (uuid) and clean up via DELETE /api/chat/{sid}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_api.py (pytest). The frontend add-night-sheet is tall - use scrollIntoView on inner selectors before clicking day/feeling/save. The chat auto-send flow via /chat?q=... works; expect SSE events {error:'Assistant indisponible pour le moment.'} + {done:true} while the Emergent LLM key budget is 0. User message is still persisted and visible in GET /api/chat/{sid}/messages on reload. Local AsyncStorage persistence works per browser session.
rca_of_issue: Bug: GET /api/chat/{session_id}/messages returned MongoDB '_id' instead of 'id'. Root cause: FastAPI's default is response_model_by_alias=True, which honored BaseDocument's alias='_id' on the id field. ChatMessage.from_mongo(doc) correctly validated '_id' -> id, but on response serialization FastAPI re-serialized using the alias, re-introducing '_id'. The frontend chat.tsx expects d.id (line 97) so every history message was being keyed with undefined, which would collide across messages and could corrupt FlatList rendering. Mitigation applied: added response_model_by_alias=False to the route. All 7 backend tests now pass and the mongo _id leak is gone.
